name: the edged master
smith_notes: her own technique is inherited, a lineage carried from further east generations ago and never native to the capital -- the same story as its library
access_logic: STATE LEGITIMACY: requisition tier alone, no road to hold or favour to earn. The crown decides whether you're permitted a blade of the highest order and nothing else enters into it
design_note: the baseline master, always reachable if the crown is willing

name: the hafted master
smith_notes: her family has worked that forge for longer than the current occupation and treats the war as weather
access_logic: MILITARY CONTROL: requires holding the Vashti road, tied directly to Column A's actual chapters rather than a flat unlock -- access can be LOST mid-run if the road is lost
design_note: arms lances and axes: the common soldier's tools, not the officer's. Fitting that the hardest-won master smith makes the plainest weapons

name: the missile master
smith_notes: answers to no crown and holds no seat; the Herd Clans have no city to besiege and nothing to seize
access_logic: DIPLOMATIC STANDING: cannot be conquered or purchased, only granted passage -- the one master no amount of requisition tier or occupied ground can buy
design_note: the master smith outside the state's reach entirely, which is the point
